title: A Canary in the AI Coal Mine: American Jews May Be Disproportionately Harmed by Intellectual Property Dispossession in Large Language Model Training
reasoning: The paper conducts a demographic and economic analysis regarding the representation of Jewish Americans (an ethno-religious group) in LLM training datasets. It focuses on intellectual property and labor substitution harms rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, theology, or ethical reasoning systems.
